frontmatter_snapshot.summary: NAV is struck once post-close and is static; IIV (also iNAV/IOPV) re-estimates the creation-unit basket value plus estimated cash roughly every 15 seconds intraday. Because it is last-trade-based it can go stale, so price, NAV, and intrinsic value form three distinct numbers.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: IIV / iNAV / IOPV: The Intraday Fair-Value Signal
